Born Without Pain: A Tragic Superpower

Imagine a life without pain... sounds like a superpower, right? 💥 But for those with CIPA, this rare genetic condition is incredibly dangerous, leading to severe injuries and tragically shorter lives. Discover the mind-bending paradox where immunity becomes vulnerability. Could you truly live without pain? 🤔
